subject: Re: Proposal follow-up — DataPath AU
body: DataPath AU is sensitive to vendor stability — they asked for our company financials and reference from 3 clients with similar scale. The CTO mentioned their previous partner suddenly reduced headcount and they were left without support for 6 weeks.

subject: Kick-off prep — TechCore JP
body: Confirmed kick-off date May 20. TechCore JP wants daily standups for the first 2 weeks, then weekly. They stressed the importance of written meeting minutes in English (not just chat). The PM mentioned previous vendors communicated only via Slack and records were lost.

subject: Objection — Data residency: InsurAI AE
body: InsurAI AE has raised a firm objection: all model training data and inference results must reside within UAE. They referenced DIFC data protection regulation. We need to clarify if our AWS ap-southeast-1 setup meets this or if we need UAE-hosted solution.

subject: Scope clarification — EduPulse UK AI tutor
body: EduPulse UK clarified that GDPR compliance is non-negotiable — no student data can be sent to US-based LLM providers. They are open to EU-hosted models (Mistral, Llama on EU infra). This significantly changes our architecture recommendation.

subject: Re: Commercial terms — RetailChain JP
body: RetailChain JP has countered on penalty clauses — they want 2% of monthly contract value per hour of downtime beyond 99.9% SLA. We need legal review before accepting. Their rationale: previous vendor caused ¥15M loss in a single incident with no compensation.

subject: Support escalation — FinTrack MY fraud alerts
body: FinTrack MY's CTO escalated: the fraud detection system missed 12 transactions in the past 24 hours due to Kafka consumer lag. They have a board meeting tomorrow and this is a critical metric. Requesting immediate RCA and fix timeline.

subject: Proposal — CloudOps ID DevOps engagement
body: CloudOps ID confirmed budget is capped at $8K/month for QA services. They are willing to stretch to $10K if we can guarantee a dedicated lead QA engineer with Selenium + Playwright experience. They have a product launch in July and zero automated test coverage today.

subject: Re: Architecture review — MedSoft US HIPAA
body: MedSoft US security team completed our architecture review. Key findings: 1) All PHI must use envelope encryption (KMS), 2) VPC with no internet gateway for DB subnets, 3) CloudTrail must be enabled with S3 Object Lock. Their compliance deadline is June 30 — this is hard.

subject: Budget concern — LogiCorp TH WMS project
body: LogiCorp TH's IT Director signaled budget was cut by 20% from original estimate. They still want the full scope but over 8 months instead of 5. Asked if we can accommodate phased billing. Their main constraint is a fiscal year budget cycle ending September.

subject: Technical questions — AnalyticsAI IN Databricks
body: AnalyticsAI IN engineering team sent 15 technical questions about our Databricks and dbt experience. They want CV of proposed engineers before contract signing. They mentioned a competitor offered 2 years of DevOps support post-delivery which we haven't matched yet.

subject: UAT sign-off request — HRCloud PH payroll
body: HRCloud PH UAT for multi-currency payroll is ready. Requesting formal sign-off by May 17. Client noted the BIR tax computation fix needs to be included in the UAT scope given recent issue.

subject: Competitive pressure — RetailEdge SG
body: RetailEdge SG shared that a Singapore-based agency quoted 30% less than us. They are weighing cost vs delivery track record. Key differentiator we should push: our team resolved their payment gateway incident within 4 hours; their previous vendor took 3 days for a similar issue.

subject: Onboarding timeline concern — DevStudio SG
body: DevStudio SG wants team onboarding to start within 2 weeks of contract signing. Their last agency took 6 weeks to fully onboard and they lost 2 months of progress. We need to confirm our bench availability before committing.

subject: Reference check — SupplyChain IN
body: SupplyChain IN asked for reference contacts from 2 similar logistics/API integration projects. They specifically asked for projects where we handled third-party API rate limiting and batch import at scale. Sending FinTrack MY and LogiCorp TH as references.

subject: Contract delay — InsurAI AE legal review
body: InsurAI AE legal is requesting 3 additional clauses: IP ownership over custom ML models, 5-year data retention after contract end, and right to audit our security practices annually. Legal review will take 2-3 weeks minimum. Project start delayed.

subject: Sprint review feedback — SmartHR AE
body: SmartHR AE's product team was pleased with the RTL fix but raised a new requirement: the Arabic date picker must support Hijri calendar alongside Gregorian. This was not in the original scope and will require 2 additional sprints.

subject: Proposal sent — FintechCo ID micro-lending
body: Sent proposal to FintechCo ID. They responded quickly asking whether we have experience with OJK (Otoritas Jasa Keuangan) sandbox and their P2P lending regulatory framework. They also want to know our approach to credit scoring model fairness documentation.

subject: Re: Scope change request — EduPulse UK
body: EduPulse UK requesting to add voice-to-text input for the AI tutor. Scope not in original contract. We estimate 3 weeks additional. Client is open to change order but wants to understand GDPR implications of voice data storage before approving.

subject: Customer complaint — CloudFirst PH AWS migration
body: CloudFirst PH raised a formal concern: the Terraform modules we delivered have hardcoded region values and no DR configuration. Their CTO is concerned about business continuity compliance. We need to remediate before they proceed with the production migration.

subject: Renewal discussion — PayScale TH
body: PayScale TH's 6-month contract ends July 31. They expressed interest in renewing for 12 months and expanding team size from 4 to 7. They flagged one concern: they want a more senior team lead — current TL is junior by their standard.
